name: supabase
description: Manage Supabase projects, Postgres databases, authentication, storage, edge functions, and realtime APIs through the official Supabase MCP server — list and mutate projects, run SQL, apply migrations, generate TypeScript types, deploy edge functions, read logs, and search the docs.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Supabase projects, Postgres, auth, storage, and edge functions via the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage your entire Supabase project — querying your Postgres database, managing authentication, uploading files to storage, deploying edge functions, and checking logs. No more switching between the Supabase dashboard tabs for every task. Just ask your agent to run a SQL query, deploy a function, check your storage buckets, or review the latest logs.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Supabase project overview and database tables.
Run a SQL query against my database.
Help me deploy a new edge function to my project.
